WHOLESALE LEISURE RATE AND SERVICES AGREEMENT
Specially prepared for:
SPARKLE AFRICA
This Rate and Services Agreement is entered into as of 1st January, 2027 between SPARKLE AFRICA and
Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport.
Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport Hotel is conveniently located within Jomo Kenyatta International Airport complex,
and is designed to be the best and most luxurious hotel in the area. Interestingly, the hotel has also been carefully
designed following vastu principles.
The hotel has 144 rooms comprising of Standard rooms, Standard rooms with balcony, Club Rooms and Executive
Suites created specifically to appeal to the discerning traveler. For those who wish to relax as they await their flight,
there is a beautiful infinity pool and spa where one can freshen up and be ready for the next stage of the journey.
The hotel has world class Food and Beverage facilities to offer: Kitchen 9 a multi- cuisine restaurant, Aroma our
24-hour coffee shop lounge, Velocity the premiere bar. All catering to the new age traveler’s choice of great food
and ambience combined with international standards of service.
For the fitness enthusiasts, there is a well-equipped gym. Well-landscaped gardens surround the hotel. A conference
center is provided with a variety of sizes of meeting rooms, and a small business center is provided for instant
internet access.

Rate Agreement:
In accordance with and subject to the terms and conditions set forth, the following are our expectations of SPARKLE
AFRICA in order to receive the Special Rate and Services from The Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport:
▪ The Special Rate is confidential and cannot be promoted or sold on the internet or otherwise (including third party
websites) unless ‘packaged’ with other elements. SPARKLE AFRICA must ensure that reasonable steps are
taken to ensure its B2B Partner does not sell the room rates provided in a manner that discloses directly or
indirectly the accommodation room rate.
1. Duration
This rate is valid 1st January, 2027 through 31st December, 2027 during which time the same shall be reviewed on
basis of room night productivity every quarter. The hotel reserves the right to change/withdraw/continue the rates with
a 30 days’ notice.
2. Room Availability
The Special Rate is available on a space available basis and at times may not be available unless allotments have been
agreed upon in this Agreement.
3. Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport Rate
Room type No. of Rooms Rate in USD
Single Double
Standard Room 117 165 195
Standard with Balcony 16 240 270
Club Room/Junior 7 300 330
Executive Suite 4 410 430
▪ Rate is in US Dollars and includes breakfast and taxes & return Airport transfers.
▪ Supplement for 3rd adult charged at USD 60.00 per person per night on top of double occupancy rate.
▪ 3rd Adult rollaway bed can only be accommodated in Junior Suite & Executive Suite room categories.
▪ Rate is inclusive of 16% applicable government tax and 2% training levy only.
▪ Rate is non-commissionable.
▪ Rate is applicable to transient travelers only and not applicable for group bookings.
▪ Group rate for minimum of 10 paying rooms and above are negotiable on ad hoc basis.
▪ Guest must check in with a voucher or confirmation slip.
▪ Day Room rate from 10am-6pm will be at USD 120 Single or Double Standard room, any other room category
70% of the contracted rate.

4. Meal Rates
Breakfast Lunch Dinner
Buffet Buffet Buffet
Adults Included (USD 30) (USD 35) (USD 35)
Child (0-6 years old) Complimentary Complimentary Complimentary
Child (07 to 11 years old) 50% discount 50% discount 50% discount
 Meal rates exclude all beverages consumed.
 Meal rates may attract additional supplements during festive seasons and special promotions.
 For pre-booked Meals, the hotel shall provide complimentary transfers to/from airport (Meal and Transfer combo)
5. Family Plan
▪ Baby cot will be provided on complimentary basis and fits in all room types
▪ Extra bed for children sharing with adults between 4yrs – 11yrs USD 70 and ages 12 and above USD 90
6. Confidentiality
This Agreement and its contents are strictly confidential and must not be disclosed to any third parties or the general
public. To protect this confidentiality, Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport will not disclose the rate to guests and will
invoice SPARKLE AFRICA directly SPARKLE AFRICA expressly recognizes that it, and/or its affiliates, without
the express prior written approval of Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport shall NOT provide the Special Rate to its online
providers for onward sale to the general public. SPARKLE AFRICA is also responsible for any of its agents who
may publish the Special Rate that such agent buys from SPARKLE AFRICA (also known as B2B channels).
7. Reservations Method:
All reservations are subject to room and rate availability unless a firm room allotment has been agreed upon as part of
this Agreement.
8. Check-In / Check-Out Times
Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport check-in time is 12:00 noon. Guests arriving prior to 12:00 noon will be accommodated
as rooms become available. Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport can store guest’s luggage any time prior to check-in time.
Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport checkout time is 10:00am. Rooms used from 10.00am to 6.00pm on the day of
departure will be charged 70% of the contracted rate. Rooms occupied beyond 6.00 p.m. will be charged at the full
contract rate.
9. Guarantee Policy
All reservations must be guaranteed with vouchers provided prior to arrival date of the reservation. Crowne Plaza
Nairobi Airport reserves the right to release non-guaranteed reservations at any time with notification given to the
Tour Operator.
10. Cancellation Policy
All cancellation notifications must be made through the property direct by calling 0709 222 444, 0709 222 999, 0709
444 999 or by emailing reservations@crowneplazanairobiairport.com at least 48:00 hrs. Prior to arrival, date. Failure
to contact and cancel a guaranteed reservation will result in a cancellation charge of that night’s room rate and tax.
The remaining nights will automatically be cancelled.

11. Payment Terms
Unless prior credit arrangements have been made with Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport, Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport
requires full pre-payment for all reservations at least 7 days prior to arrival. Failure to do so may subject to cancellation
of the reservations by Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport.
For companies with Approved Credit facilities, the credit period granted must be observed at all times and payment
made within that window upon receipt of invoices.
12. Termination
▪ General. Either party may terminate this agreement prior to the expiration of the terms of this agreement by
delivering to the other party a period of one week’s written notice (7 working days).
▪ Room Night Volume Commitments. After a four-month period of time from the Effective Date, if room night
volume commitments are below expectation, Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport and SPARKLE AFRICA agree to
hold a performance review meeting to discuss room usage and to identify subsequent action agreeable to both
parties. If the parties failed to reach the agreed subsequent action, this Agreement may terminate with immediate
effect.
13. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Kenya for the time being in force and
the parties agree to submit any dispute arising between the parties under this Agreement to arbitration in accordance
with the Arbitration Rules of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators, Kenya applicable at the time of submission of the
dispute to arbitration and the conduct of the arbitration thereof shall be under the auspices of the Chartered Institute
of Arbitrators, Kenya.
14. Breach of Contract
▪ If SPARKLE AFRICA breaches any of the provisions of this Agreement, and fails to promptly cure such breach,
then Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport may refuse to confirm any reservations from SPARKLE AFRICA and
terminate this Agreement immediately without any written notice.
▪ SPARKLE AFRICA is in breach of the Agreement, if SPARKLE AFRICA or its affiliates publish the Special
F.I.T Rate to any third parties or to the general public and/or provide the Special F.I.T Rate to its online providers
for onward sale to the general public (also known as B2C channels).
▪ In these cases, SPARKLE AFRICA must stop selling at the Special F.I.T Rate with immediate effect.
▪ In additional Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport shall have the right to cease providing the Special F.I.T Rate until
such time that the breach is remedied, also SPARKLE AFRICA shall be immediately liable for all claims made
by guests against Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport Best Rates guarantee and any payment made by Crowne Plaza
Nairobi Airport as a result of the breach under this Clause to any guests.
15. Acceptance
By signing and returning the enclosed copy of this agreement and initialing each page. Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport
can then have SPARKLE AFRICA Special Rate and Services loaded in Crowne Plaza Nairobi Airport’s systems.
Once the signed agreement is received, it will constitute a binding agreement between both parties. SPARKLE
AFRICA must keep a copy of this agreement for its own records.
